> - **Kiosk 1 back:** 11:03 AM. Guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch confirmed it.
> - **Both lanes confirmed working:** 11:07 AM.
> - **Status:** Carrowmere Cloud was checking the Hartford gateway route. The channel doesn't record a root cause. The incident stays open for another arrival cycle. The separate status-page access issue is still being worked under INC-4821.

I haven't sent this to Mateo's team or posted it anywhere else. Let me know if you want it sent to them or changed.
